description: Zero-shot multilingual (600+ language) TTS from the k2-fsa/sherpa/icefall team, run locally via the omnivoice/torch runtime. Supports voice cloning (ref_audio), free-text voice design (instruct), or letting the model pick a speaker automatically ('auto', used here). Arabic is first-class, with 22 regional varieties as distinct lang tags.
notes: Runs a local multi-GB model (CPU or CUDA, auto-detected); no API key or remote server required, unlike the Azure/Google cloud TTS fighters. GPU strongly recommended for real-time synthesis; 'lazy' loading is the plugin default so config-only validation does not require the weights.
